title: launch --help or -h as the first word prints the launch usage on stdout and exits 0, in or outside a git checkout, touching nothing
source: cli/jitso/launch.ts: parseLaunchArgs (`--help` is not in the value flags)
intent: INTENDED behavior (TS-ODDITIES L10, defect N-26). When the first word after `launch` is --help or -h, jitso prints the launch usage on stdout and exits 0: nothing on stderr, no project, catalog or Orca needed, no launch folder. Anywhere else the word stays an unknown argument (validation/unknown-flag keeps its --help and -h rows). The oracle rejects both words as an unknown argument with exit 2, so the exit code and the stdout expectations FAIL on TS.
